  "situation": "Subordinates in a federal agency wish to raise a collection to purchase a gift for their official superior who is being sworn in to a higher‑grade position. The regulation 5 CFR 2635.304(c) permits voluntary contributions for gifts on special, infrequent occasions or for shared refreshments. Example 3 to paragraph (c) states that collections for a gift on a swearing‑in or promotion are not allowed because those events are not personal‑significance occasions. The same example allows a collection for refreshments to be shared by the office on such occasions. The subordinates seek guidance on whether they may collect for the gift.",
